inputRootSignature: theorem exact_student_t_distribution_ols_contrast {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n p : ℕ) (hnp : p < n) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (hX : Function.Injective X.mulVec) (betaStar : Fin p → ℝ) (sigma : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (epsilon : Ω → Fin n → ℝ) (hgaussian : ∀ b : Fin n → ℝ, HasLaw (fun ω ↦ dotProduct b (epsilon ω)) (gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (sigma ^ 2 * dotProduct b b))) P) (a : Fin p → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : ℝ) (hnull : dotProduct a betaStar = c) : let y : Ω → Fin n → ℝ := fun ω ↦ X *ᵥ betaStar + epsilon ω let betaHat : Ω → Fin p → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (X.transpose * X)⁻¹ *ᵥ (X.transpose *ᵥ y ω) let sigmaHatSq : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ dotProduct (y ω - X *ᵥ betaHat ω) (y ω - X *ᵥ betaHat ω) / ((n - p : ℕ) : ℝ) let statistic : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (dotProduct a (betaHat ω) - c) / (Real.sqrt (sigmaHatSq ω) * Real.sqrt (dotProduct a ((X.transpose * X)⁻¹ *ᵥ a))) let nu : ℝ := ((n - p : ℕ) : ℝ) let density : ℝ → ℝ := fun z ↦ Real.Gamma ((nu + 1) / 2) / (Real.sqrt (nu * Real.pi) * Real.Gamma (nu / 2)) * Real.rpow (1 + z ^ 2 / nu) (-(nu + 1) / 2) let studentT : Measure ℝ := volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (density z)) HasLaw statistic studentT P
